tools.name: viewer_get_state
tools.description: Return the current Mol* semantic camera, loaded structures, and symmetry preset.

tools.name: viewer_reset
tools.description: Rebuild the default structure hierarchy and restore the initial Mol* camera and visibility.

tools.name: sv3d_orbit
tools.description: Look at the structure from an absolute world azimuth and elevation, in degrees.

tools.name: viewer_zoom
tools.description: Set the Mol* camera distance as an absolute multiple of the distance that just fits the visible structure. Greater than 1 is closer.

tools.name: viewer_pan
tools.description: Offset the Mol* look-at point from the visible-sphere centre, along camera-right and camera-up, as fractions of the visible radius. pan_right > 0 moves the look-at toward screen-right, so the structure slides left.

tools.name: sv3d_measure
tools.description: Start an atom-bound distance, angle, or dihedral measurement and record the completed result.

tools.name: sv3d_clear_measurements
tools.description: Clear every Mol* distance, angle, and dihedral annotation.

tools.name: sv3d_switch_structure
tools.description: Show exactly one loaded structure and hide the others.

tools.name: sv3d_set_symmetry
tools.description: Apply a Mol* trajectory preset: the deposited model (every crystallographic copy), the biological assembly (Assembly 1), crystal contacts, the unit cell, or a super cell.

tools.name: sv3d_set_camera
tools.description: Restore a semantic Mol* camera. Internal utility used to snap the view back to a recorded trajectory head; never an expert action and never recorded.

tools.name: sv3d_set_component_visibility
tools.description: Show or hide Mol* auto-preset components (water, ligand, polymer, ion, carbohydrate). Omitted keys stay unchanged.

tools.name: sv3d_set_representation
tools.description: Set the Mol* representation of an auto-preset component class (polymer, ligand, carbohydrate), every component, or one picked residue overlay. Restyle carbohydrate to ball-and-stick to expose the atoms its SNFG symbol hides.

tools.name: sv3d_clash
tools.description: Scan model-0 occupied heavy NonPolymer vs Polymer atoms for the maximum van der Waals overlap, excluding direct _struct_conn pairs.

tools.name: sv3d_get_unit_cell
tools.description: Read the crystallographic unit-cell lengths, angles, volume, and Hermann-Mauguin space group from the loaded CIF.

tools.name: sv3d_measure_atoms
tools.description: Measure the distance between two atoms identified by chain, residue number, and atom name.

tools.name: sv3d_set_chain_visibility
tools.description: Show one polymer chain (with its ligands, waters, ions and covalently attached glycans) and hide the rest, or show all chains again.

tools.name: sv3d_focus_residue
tools.description: Focus one residue by chain and sequence id: draws the residue, its surrounding environment and their non-covalent interactions, then aims the camera at it. Replaces any previous focus.

tools.name: sv3d_set_atom_labels
tools.description: Show or hide screen-space serial-number labels on atoms identified by _atom_site.id or XYZ line numbers.
